public_rationale: At launch, Google reported that Gemini 3 Pro ranked first on LMArena and posted top scores on Humanity's Last Exam, GPQA Diamond and other benchmarks. A launch-day news summary of the comparison table says it beat Anthropic and OpenAI models in nearly all tests. The independent evaluator Artificial Analysis put it first overall on its Intelligence Index. There were exceptions: Claude edged it on SWE-bench Verified, and Artificial Analysis had it first on 5 of 10 component evals. His hedge 'on most measures' allows for such exceptions, so the claim holds on its plain reading.
limitations: Much of the comparison comes from Google's own chosen benchmarks.
Independent component-level results show leadership on about half the evals, not an overwhelming majority.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Gemini 3 is better than any other model on most measures.

statement.excerpt: Google announced their big new state-of-the-art model yesterday, Gemini 3, on most measures better than any other model out there.

from_speaker: better than any other model out there
our_interpretation: Plain reading: at launch, Gemini 3 (Pro) scored first against the other frontier models on most of the widely cited benchmarks and leaderboards.
'Most measures' is read as a majority of the standard benchmarks reported at launch, including independent leaderboards, not every single test.
criteria.support_condition: Launch-time benchmark results (company and independent) show Gemini 3 ranked first on a majority of standard measures against rival frontier models.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Launch-time results show rival models leading on most standard benchmarks, or Gemini 3 leading on only a minority.

evidence.excerpt: It tops the LMArena Leaderboard with a breakthrough score of 1501 Elo. It demonstrates PhD-level reasoning with top scores on Humanity’s Last Exam (37.5% without the usage of any tools) and GPQA Diamond (91.9%).
evidence.locator: section 'State-of-the-art reasoning with unprecedented depth and nuance', paragraph 2
evidence.explanation: Google reports that Gemini 3 Pro ranked first on LMArena and posted top scores on major reasoning benchmarks at launch.

evidence.excerpt: The model outperforms all other models in Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. It demonstrates strength across the board, coming in first in 5 of the 10 evaluations that make up Intelligence Index.
evidence.explanation: An independent evaluator put Gemini 3 Pro first overall. It led 5 of 10 component evals, plus its own knowledge benchmark and MMMU-Pro, so it did not lead every measure.

evidence.excerpt: Gemini 3 Pro, has posted dominant results across a comprehensive suite of industry benchmarks, outperforming competing models from Anthropic and OpenAI in nearly all tests.
evidence.explanation: A launch-day news summary of the comparison table says Gemini 3 Pro beat Anthropic and OpenAI models on nearly all tests.

evidence.excerpt: 76.2% on SWE-Bench Verified for single-attempt coding tasks, though Claude’s 77.2% edged it out on the latter.
evidence.explanation: Shows an exception: Gemini 3 did not lead every measure. This fits his word 'most'.
